hash_rules.fingerprint: sha256: + sha256(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=True, allow_nan=False))
hash_rules.generation_id: fingerprint({k: manifest[k] for k in MANIFEST_KEYS})

producer_timeout_retry_guidance.per_request_client_timeout_seconds: Must tolerate engine per-request Supabase work up to 12s plus RTT. A 20s producer client timeout is not contract-forbidden pending measurement; lowering below 12 risks cutting off legitimate store waits.
producer_timeout_retry_guidance.retries: Retry only with identical immutable object_id/envelope_id. 503/transport → retry; 422 → fix payload (do not retry); 409 → conflict, do not overwrite; 401/403 → stop. Object ACK status=duplicate and finalize receipt status=duplicate are successful idempotent replays.
producer_timeout_retry_guidance.total_wall_clock: M1 serial path is 5 HTTP calls. Bound total wall clock as N_ops × per_request_client_timeout × (1 + retry_budget), independent of the 12s-per-Supabase-request constant. Vercel 60s caps a single server invocation, not the producer's multi-request job.

limits.timeout_clarification: Engine urllib open(..., timeout=12) applies per Supabase store HTTP request inside a handler — not a whole-capture or multi-request producer budget. Vercel maxDuration is 60s per function invocation. Do not reinterpret 12s as total capture time, and do not demand exporter client 20→12 without measured per-request latency evidence.
